_readme: Single source of truth for the directory. `pinnedId` decides which community holds the featured slot at the top of every listing. Entries with "example": true are demo data used to exercise the search, filter, sort and stats features - delete them once real listings exist (see README.md). Add a real community with: npm run add <discord invite>

communities.name: Norax
communities.description: This server is made for Norax and his fam aka supporters. Come on and join the family already!

communities.name: Pixel Forge
communities.description: A workshop server for pixel artists, sprite animators and anyone who likes their art a little blocky.

communities.name: Night Shift
communities.description: A late-hours hangout for insomniacs, shift workers and anyone whose day starts when everyone else logs off.

communities.name: Tempo
communities.description: Producers, mixers and bedroom musicians swapping stems, feedback and far too many plugin recommendations.

communities.name: First Light
communities.description: A small reading and study room. Timed focus sessions every morning, quiet voice channels the rest of the day.

communities.name: LAN Party
communities.description: Nightly stacks across shooters, party games and whatever is on sale. Casual queues, no rank gatekeeping.

communities.name: Null Pointer
communities.description: Developers helping developers. Code review threads, a job board and a channel purely for cursed bugs.

communities.name: Sakura Lane
communities.description: Seasonal anime watch parties, manga threads and a very opinionated recommendations channel.

communities.name: Driftwood
communities.description: A long-running collaborative roleplay setting. Lore archive, character apps and weekly story sessions.
